name: kg-andp-semantic
display_name: Knowledge Graph Constructor - AI-Native Data Product
description: Build a Knowledge Graph deterministically from a DEPLOYED AI-Native Data Product. The product already publishes an agent-discoverable catalog of itself — modules, entities, columns with meanings and PII classifications, join paths, a business glossary, proven query recipes, design decisions, naming standards, lineage and data-quality readings. All of it is walked directly into the two-layer topology. No LLM, no MCP, zero tokens.
author: TDA Core Team

auto_generate.description: Deterministic, zero-token construction: connect to a database connection, discover which AI-Native Data Products are deployed there, read the chosen product's own catalog, and walk it into entities and relationships. Reproducible, free, and re-syncable when the product's catalog changes.

connection_id.description: Database connection holding the deployed product. Credentials are resolved through the platform's encrypted connection store.

product.description: The AI-Native Data Product to read, discovered from the selected connection.

semantic_database.description: Override discovery and read this semantic database directly. Empty = the standard's own discovery order (registry → {Product}_Semantic convention → dictionary scan).

discovery_mode.description: Strategy selector — fixed for this template.

include_columns.description: Include attribute and column nodes carrying each column's meaning, PII/sensitivity classification and decoded value codes. Off = a compact entity-level graph.

include_physical.description: Include the physical layer (schema/table/column) with real queryable identifiers and types read from the data dictionary. Required for the grounding gate's trusted scope.

include_product_knowledge.description: Include the product's own description of itself: business glossary, proven query recipes, design decisions, naming standards, lineage and data-quality readings — each linked to the entity or table it concerns.

include_non_business_modules.description: Include the product's self-describing modules (Semantic, Memory, Observability) as structure. Off = business Domain module only.

max_value_codes.description: Cap on decoded values kept per attribute, bounding node payloads on columns with very large code lists.

manual.description: Knowledge graphs are populated via the constructor.

document_upload.description: Knowledge graphs are populated from the deployed product, not documents.

logical_entities.description: Logical layer — the product's meaning, plus what it publishes about itself

physical_entities.description: Physical layer — the deployed, queryable realization
